endpoint.selection: Exact explicit vmware/v36_3 scoped override; official Selectel region hosts are vcd.selectel.ru (SPB), vcd-msk.selectel.ru (MSK); no arbitrary LoginUrl follow-up
endpoint.scope: Explicit account/project/region; pool optional and never inferred; ownership not asserted by anonymous discovery

request.auth: Compiled immutable anonymous discovery exception for this exact operation only; ProtocolSpecific remains gated elsewhere; no CredentialSource lookup or credentials sent

response.mapping: Source-bound generated SupportedVersions with VersionInfo/AlphaVersion/MediaTypeMapping/SchemaRoot; deprecated optional bool preserved, no active-version default; no implicit choice or authentication from returned URLs
response.xml: Exact versions namespace at all elements, compiled children/attributes only, duplicate singleton fields rejected; no DTD/external entities or schemaLocation fetch; bounded core body size

errors.mapping: Shared bounded status/error handling; raw provider messages omitted; malformed XML/foreign namespaces/duplicate versions ProtocolError

retry: Shared bounded safe read retry/context/CallTimeout; no auth retry material or alternate endpoint
